benchmarkTitle: iTantra 10-Language Speech Accuracy & End-to-End Latency Benchmark Report
environment: Physical Android Benchmark (Phone A: Samsung Galaxy A55 5G [RZCY9396AGX] / Phone B: Samsung Galaxy Note 10 Lite [RF8N927PM9N]) + Verified Host JVM Corpus Engine

phoneA.soc: Samsung Exynos 1480 (4x Cortex-A78 @ 2.75 GHz + 4x Cortex-A55 @ 2.05 GHz)
phoneA.role: Speech Capture, Neural INT8 STT Inference, NLP Entity Extraction, Wire Egress

phoneB.soc: Samsung Exynos 9810 (4x Exynos M3 @ 2.7 GHz + 4x Cortex-A55 @ 1.7 GHz)
phoneB.role: Wire Ingress, Packet Deserialization, Neural VITS TTS Synthesis, Acoustic Audio Output

hardwareProfile.rfLink: Direct Wi-Fi Direct / Local Ad-hoc 802.11ac 5GHz Subnet (Measured single-hop latency: 31.8 ms)

PIPE_C.pipelineName: Pipeline C: Feature 16A Pipelined Two-Pass Overlapped
